scope: Three separate transparent cartoon resource sprite previews

assets.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: an original transparent game resource sprite PREVIEW for this project's hand-painted cartoon tower-defense game. Image 1 is the edit target and approved resource-shape reference; Image 2 is only a style reference, especially its bottom gameplay strip. Transform the Image 1 resource into smooth clean CARTOON 2D painted sprite artwork matching Image 2's crisp dark brown outlines, broad readable painted volumes, soft contact shading and restrained highlights. Orthographic isometric view, camera 55 degrees above the ground horizon, light from upper left. A single isolated complete resource object, centered with generous transparent margins and a tight grounded base, visible top and front. Truly transparent RGBA background including all surrounding pixels; only a subtle compact semitransparent contact shadow immediately under the object. No grass floor, no ground tile or pedestal, no background scenery, text, labels, UI, tools, people or other resource objects. Preserve the approved subject identity and broad silhouette, while changing rendering into this project's cartoon sprite style. No low-poly 3D render, pixel art, photorealism, dense texture noise, white outline, glow or cropped edges. Subject specifics: one compact, full healthy conifer with a clear tapered triangular silhouette, four or five overlapping pointed needle bough tiers, olive/yellow-green lit foliage and dark forest-green undersides, a short visible warm brown grooved trunk and a few small exposed roots. Keep the chunky, gently curved needle masses and irregular natural silhouette of the reference; no ornaments, snow, cut logs or giant rounded leaves. Draw broad foliage clumps that remain readable at actual small gameplay scale.
